about: The controls the validation report (docs/model/validation.md, #119) lists under implementation and controls. Each names the guard in the code and the test that holds it. scripts/validation_report.py refuses an entry whose guard or test file is missing, or whose test carries no recorded mutation, so a control cannot be listed after it has stopped being tested. The kinds are the ones docs/decisions/information-set.md and lockbox.md name.

controls.what: an input read after the decision instant
an input older than the latest value public at the decision instant
a scheduled settlement or announced IORB change dated after its public instant
a settlement result read before its auction results time
a scored day in a tier the lockbox has not opened
the live record's days kept out of every comparison
the final test's declaration, its checksum and its frozen command
the live log's digests, so a logged forecast cannot change after the fact
every generated page is what its generator renders from the records
